nodes.summary: Let $C_n = \binom{2n}{n} / (n + 1)$ be the $n$-th Catalan number. For a real number $\alpha$, there is a real sequence $(a_k)_{k \ge 0}$ with $a_{2k+1} = 0$ for every $k$ such that, for every $N \ge 0$, the difference $C_n \sqrt{\pi} \, (n + \alpha)^{3/2} / 4^n - \sum_{k=0}^{N} a_k (n + \alpha)^{-k}$ is $o\left((n + \alpha)^{-N}\right)$ as $n \to \infty$, if and only if $\alpha = 3/4$.

nodes.title: Stirling-type asymptotic expansions of the Catalan numbers

nodes.summary: Let $c$ be a real number, let $C_n$ be the $n$-th Catalan number and $B_k(x)$ the $k$-th Bernoulli polynomial, and for $j \ge 0$ put $a_j = (-1)^j \left(B_{j+2}(1/2 - c) - B_{j+2}(2 - c)\right) / ((j + 1)(j + 2))$. Then for every natural number $M$, $(n + c)^M \left(\log\left(C_n \sqrt{\pi (n + c)^3} / 4^n\right) - \sum_{j=0}^{M-1} a_j (n + c)^{-(j+1)}\right) \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$.
